'''Wyx''' was a [[BII Butler Droid]] owned by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Haydnat Treen]] of the planet [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. The droid had been in her [[Treen family|family]] for generations and, in Treen's opinion, would continue to do so. His torso had been painted in her family's [[Color/Legends|colors]] of blue and gold.<ref name="Ascension" />
